Board of Education BOE Meeting Schedule

BOE Meeting Agendas and Minutes

The Nashua Board of Education (BOE) meeting minutes are posted on the school district's website. Historical minutes are on file in the Office of the Superintendent. If you have questions about Nashua Board of Education minutes, please contact the Office of the Superintendent at 603-966-1000.
